rules.text: You may exchange an item free of charge within 30 days of receipt.
rules.quote: If you would like to exchange an item, you may do so free of charge within 30 days of receipt.

rules.text: Exchanges for select handbags, shoes, wallets and clothing items may be initiated online.
rules.quote: Exchanges for select handbags, shoes, wallets and clothing items may be initiated online.

rules.text: You must ship the original item to the distribution center within 3 days of initiating the exchange.
rules.quote: To ensure inventory availability, please ship the original item to our distribution center within 3 days of initiating the exchange.

rules.text: If the replacement item is not available, you will receive a full refund to your original form of payment.
rules.quote: Please note if the replacement item is not available, you will receive a full refund to your original form of payment.

rules.text: If the original item is not received at the distribution center, the exchange will be cancelled.
rules.quote: Lastly, if we do not receive your original item at our distribution center, your exchange will be cancelled.

rules.category: outlet orders and items marked "Final Sale"
rules.text: All outlet orders and items marked "Final Sale" are not eligible for returns, exchanges, or price adjustments.
rules.quote: All outlet orders and items marked "Final Sale" are not eligible for returns, exchanges, or price adjustments.

rules.text: Original items must be unused, unworn with original hangtags and packaging attached to be eligible for exchange.
rules.quote: Original items must be unused, unworn with original hangtags and packaging attached.

rules.text: Initial shipping charges are not refundable.
rules.quote: Initial shipping charges are not refundable.
